svg.title: The Six-Day War and Territories Conquered by Israel (5–10 June 1967)
svg.desc: Pearson Edexcel GCSE History cartographic map contrasting Pre-1967 Israel inside the 1949 Green Line against the four territories captured in June 1967: the Sinai Peninsula and Gaza Strip from Egypt, East Jerusalem and the West Bank from Jordan, and the Golan Heights from Syria, alongside Nasser's 22 May closure of the Straits of Tiran and the 5 June pre-emptive air strikes.

g.text: Israeli jets fly beneath radar to destroy
300+ Egyptian aircraft on tarmac in 3 hrs,
deciding the ground war in Sinai.
Nasser expels UNEF & closes straits to
Israeli oil shipping bound for Eilat —
(Sinai, Gaza, West Bank, E. Jerusalem, Golan)
